issues.description: At most eight high-confidence findings, ordered by practical impact. Use an empty array only after completing the review.

file.description: Exact listed repository-relative POSIX path, without absolute paths, backslashes, empty segments, dot segments, or traversal.

column.description: One-based source column; use 1 if unknown.

message.description: Concise triggering condition, proven consequence, and corrective action. Never reproduce secrets or control characters.
